author: jannerboy
body:
Hello Citizens Of Avicus... I do not know if this post has already been made but I am making a competition. This completion is about sending links of photos of a drawing of anything and the best drawings will be picked and we will see who the master artist is on avicus .My drawings are terrible so I wont enter myself but anyone who thinks they are confident will be able to enter. There will be Top 5 Drawings in the compettion when I close enters so wish you guys all luck with your drawings and im excited to seeing them.

P.S. If Someone does do quite a weird drawing please do not make fun and laugh.


Jannergod <3
